## 席位意见(增量)· director seat (summon #43 continuation 2, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`), read as batch #356 item 1, 2026-10-16T12:46Z

**This card is a fork of a standing ruling.** #23775 asked the same door's question on 2026-10-16T01:05Z and the maintainer ruled it **B** at 6212082860 (2026-10-16T09:08Z, batch #354 item 1): a retired flow spelling is refused on a NEW flow (no stored row of that name at the save's resolution scope) with the parse refusal and prescription; a re-save of a stored row keeps the full chain so a legacy row stays editable in Studio; the engine's rehydration and the read path are untouched; `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, `domain:engine`. PR #23902 executes it (`Fixes #23775`; contract review 6215619986 PASS; 速读终稿 6215638408; Tier H, awaiting approval). This card's filer did not have that ruling in view (the body cites `origin/main` `570f01d270` and names no card; its dedupe searched terms, not the open card). So:
- **Its A and B are already decided**: A was not taken; B, in the form the ruling gives, is in flight.
- **Two sub-questions are new**, and the director puts them to the maintainer rather than self-ruling, because the first narrows the save door's accept set for EXISTING rows (a contract narrowing, which went to the maintainer on #23775 as well):
  - **(i) B′ — a retired spelling that a re-save NEWLY INTRODUCES on an existing flow** (an author or an AI adds a node with `http_request` to an old flow): under the ruling it is healed silently with the rest of the row; this card's B would refuse it. The predicate is a diff of conversion hits between the request body and the stored row's body (a hit in the request that the stored row does not carry ⇒ authored input ⇒ refuse with the prescription).
  - **(ii) C — canonicalize flows on READ** (`getMetaItem`, `getMetaItems`, `getMetaItemLayered`, `loadMetaFromDb` through the resolver, with the no-engine fallback) and then refuse every retired spelling at save.

**Premises re-run in this act, objectstack `origin/main` `d5666be876`:**
1. The save door canonicalizes `flow` bodies before the schema gate (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:22925`). Holds.
2. The fallback verdict replays retired entries (`protocol.ts:23028`, `includeRetired: true`; the line PR #23902 makes conditional). Holds.
3. Reads skip `flow` deliberately (`protocol.ts:6464`): the node-type rename's conflict guard needs the engine's live executor registry; ADR-0087's 2026-08-01c addendum says reads were not changed and the resolver is the seam they would adopt if that changes. Holds.
4. The authored doors refuse the same spellings (the F2 / F3 / F4 landing records on #23543). Holds, as the card says.
- Prior rulings (`check-prior-rulings.mjs --card 23903`): 554 broad candidates, none on this door; the ruling of record is 6212082860 on #23775, which the tool cannot see from this card's thread (0 comments). Governing text as #23775's: ADR-0087 addendum 2026-07-31 (「writes stay gated … new rows are always canonical」), the 2026-08-02 save-seam addendum, ruling 6182001882 items 6–7.

**Facets, on the two new sub-questions:**
- ① — (i) draws the ruling's own line more exactly: a node an author adds today is authored input, whatever row it lands in; the ruled B leaves one door where authored input is healed silently. (ii) is the end state the card paints, but ADR-0087 deliberately keeps flows out of read-time conversion because the rename conflict guard needs the live executor registry; the at-rest path is `os migrate meta --stored`; the ruling on #23775 weighed C and did not take it.
- ② — zero measured pull on both: no in-repo producer, Studio writes the blocks; the clients (i) is for are AI callers adding nodes through MCP / REST, unmeasured.
- ③ — (i) closes the last silent-healing seam on authored input with the same loud 422 and prescription; (ii) adds nothing an author sees that (i) does not, except that a served legacy row reads canonical.
- ④ — (i) is one comparison predicate inside the predicate PR #23902 already added (the stored row is read there), carried forever; (ii) touches four read seams and removes a special case ADR-0087 chose on purpose, the larger one-time cost.

**Recommend: (i) B′ yes, as its own `domain:engine` follow-up card after PR #23902 lands, p2; (ii) C no.** Fallback for (i): no (the ruled B stands as the whole answer). Not C: the ruling already declined it, the read-side special case is ADR-0087's deliberate design, and zero pull does not buy four read seams. 口径 for (i), binding with the letter:
1. The predicate compares conversion hits: a retired entry that fires on the request body and does not fire on the stored row's body ⇒ the save is judged as authored input (`includeRetired: false`) and meets the refusal and prescription; a request whose retired hits are all carried by the stored row keeps the full chain (the ruled B).
2. Server-stated writes (the stored-metadata migration, `package-duplicate`, `package-unmanaged-import`) stay on the full chain, as PR #23902 reads them.
3. Pins: adding a node with a retired type to a stored legacy flow → 422 located; re-saving the served legacy body unchanged → healed as before; a new flow with a retired spelling → 422 (unchanged from B).
4. `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`, contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; one PR after #23902; its changeset first paragraph names the re-save case.

**Workload:** (i) = `domain:engine` · 1 PR · precedent PR #23902 (the predicate it extends). (ii) = `domain:engine` · 1–2 PRs · no precedent, not recommended. Under 「(i) no」: 0 PRs; this card closes as a duplicate of #23775.

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:(i) 把裁决「作者输入拒、静置数据重放」的线画得更准(再存时新加的节点也是作者输入);(ii) 读侧规范化动了 ADR-0087 有意保留的特例,裁决 6212082860 已不取。
- ② 实际业务拉动:两项都零实测拉动;(i) 针对的是经 MCP/REST 往旧 flow 加节点的 AI 调用方,未实测。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:(i) 关掉作者输入最后一处静默自愈,与 `os validate` 同文响亮拒绝;(ii) 对作者看到的东西不比 (i) 多。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:(i) 是 PR #23902 已有谓词里再加一次比较;(ii) 四处读取接缝,一次性代价最大。

自检:只看①(i) 选是、(ii) 选否;②③④ 是否翻转:否(② 零拉动只定时序——排在 #23902 之后)。

## Triage: intake, the face is complete · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T13:00Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **The face is complete:** a quick-read summary for the maintainer, three options, a recommendation (C) and a fallback (B), and the two governing records quoted. It goes to the maintainer in this seat's round report.
- **After the ruling:** the execution lane is `domain:engine` (`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`), with `domain:spec` for the conversion side, as the card names. Triage adds the grade then. Its reading now: p1 + `target:v18` if the ruling narrows the save door (C or B), under the protocol-first rule.
- **Order:** F5-http (claim `6214417833`) leaves `protocol.ts` untouched, so it does not wait on this ruling.

Ruling: batch #356 item 1 · letter B′ (i) yes · C (ii) no · maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-16T13:09Z

Director seat, summon #43 continuation 2, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`, on this card read as a fork of ruling 6212082860 (#23775, batch #354 item 1, letter B), the director delta 6215813374 and the premise re-run on `origin/main` `d5666be876` (opening marker 6215805629). The maintainer's word in this session's chat: 「同意」 on batch #356.

**What the ruling binds:**
1. **A and B as this card spells them are already decided** by 6212082860: A not taken; B, in the ruling's form, is in flight as PR #23902 (`Fixes #23775`).
2. **(i) B′ — yes.** A retired flow spelling that a re-save NEWLY INTRODUCES on a stored flow is authored input and is refused like a new flow's. The predicate compares conversion hits: a retired entry that fires on the request body and does not fire on the stored row's body ⇒ the save is judged with `includeRetired: false` and meets the parse refusal and prescription (422, `INVALID_METADATA`, located, the `os validate` text); a request whose retired hits are all carried by the stored row keeps the full chain (the ruled B). Server-stated writes (the stored-metadata migration, `package-duplicate`, `package-unmanaged-import`) stay on the full chain, as PR #23902 reads them. The engine's rehydration and the read path are untouched.
3. **(ii) C — no.** Flows are not canonicalized on read: ADR-0087's 2026-08-01c addendum keeps `flow` out of `convertStoredItem` on purpose (the node-type rename's conflict guard needs the live executor registry, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:6464`); the at-rest path stays `os migrate meta --stored`; 6212082860 weighed C and did not take it; zero measured pull buys no read seams.
4. **Pins for (i):** adding a node with a retired type to a stored legacy flow → 422 located, naming the new key; re-saving the served legacy body unchanged → healed as before; a new flow with a retired spelling → 422 (unchanged from B); the same through the REST door.
5. **Lane and shape:** `domain:engine` (`packages/metadata-protocol`), one PR after PR #23902 lands, extending its `flowSaveReplaysRetired` predicate; `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` of the save door's accept set for existing rows; contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; the changeset's first paragraph names the re-save case.

**Workload of the letter** (the card's column): (i) = `domain:engine` · 1 PR · precedent PR #23902 (the predicate it extends). (ii) = 0 PRs.

**Execution:** this card is the follow-up execution card: `needs-user-decision` removed; `domain:engine`, `priority:p2` and `pm:blocked` added in this act, with `Blocked-by: #23775` on the body (the unlock is #23775's close when PR #23902 lands); the body's first line carries `Ruled:`. The spec seat's F5-http work is unaffected (it leaves `protocol.ts` untouched). A pointer to this record goes on #23775.

## Unlock scan: `pm:blocked` → `pm:queue` · PR #23902 landed · regraded p2 → **p1** + `target:v18` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T14:21Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **The wait is spent.** `Blocked-by: #23775`: #23775 closed `completed` at 2026-10-16T13:12Z, when PR #23902 merged (`cf071687f1`). Ruling item 5 (`6216220018`) asks for one PR after #23902 lands, extending its `flowSaveReplaysRetired` predicate. That PR can start now.
- **Why p1 + `target:v18`, not p2:** the ruling itself names the change `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` of the save door's accept set. A narrowing of a `/meta` door is the protocol-first class. The maintainer's grading rule makes it p1 + `target:v18` in every lane (「立卡，规则扩到所有车道，REST 收窄也算」), and this seat's intake `6216058760` read it the same way.
  - The ruling's letter, lane (`domain:engine`) and shape are unchanged. Only the grade moves. If the director meant p2 against that rule, it can be set back here.
